Focus Life works entirely on your phone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is analysed in the cloud, and there is no account.
Needed for routine reminders, revision alerts and your daily report.
Lets Focus Life read total screen time so the dashboard and weekly comparison are accurate. It reads minutes per app only — never message content, never what you type, never what you watch.
Lets Focus Life notice when a blocked app opens so it can show the warning screen. It compares package names against your list. It does not read the screen, record touches, or see inside any app.
Needed to draw the full-screen block warning on top of a distracting app.
Optional, but recommended on OPPO / ColorOS so reminders are not delayed. Focus Life uses almost no background CPU.
Without this, routine, revision and workout reminders will not appear. Everything else still works.
Without this, screen time shows as “not available” instead of a number, and app limits cannot be measured. Your Focus Score adjusts rather than dropping.
Without this, Study, Running, Sleep and Deep Focus modes warn you but cannot actually stop a blocked app from opening.
Without this, the block warning cannot appear on top of another app, so a blocked app opens before you see the message.
Optional. Without this, reminders and background statistics may be delayed by the system while the phone is idle.
That settings screen is not available on this device. Open Settings manually and find Focus Life in the app list.
No internet permission — the app cannot send anything anywhere.
No reading of messages, photos, contacts or app content.
No hidden monitoring. Every permission is listed above and can be revoked in Settings at any time.
All data stays in a local database on this phone.
Focus Life works without notifications, but routine and revision reminders will not appear. You can enable them later in Settings.
Without Usage access the dashboard shows study, focus and habit data but cannot measure mobile usage. Everything else still works.
Without the Distraction Guard, Focus Life cannot detect that a blocked app opened. Modes, timers and all tracking still work normally.
Without overlay permission the block warning cannot be drawn over other apps. Blocking will notify you instead.
Settings → Apps → Special app access → Usage access → Focus Life → Allow
Settings → Accessibility → Downloaded services → Focus Life Distraction Guard → turn on
Settings → Apps → Focus Life → Allow display over other apps
Android may show a system warning when enabling this service. It appears for every accessibility app; Focus Life uses the service only to detect which app is in the foreground.
Language follows your phone setting by default. Choose here to override it for Focus Life only.
Save a copy of everything as a text file on this phone.
Clears today\'s ticks, logs and sessions. History from earlier days is kept.
Clear everything recorded for today? This cannot be undone.
Deletes the entire local database and restores defaults.
This permanently deletes every habit, streak, session and report on this phone. Type RESET to confirm.
Fully offline — no account, no cloud, no ads, no trackers

My family has invested in me. Finishing what I started is how I repay that.
The version of me two years from now is built entirely by what I choose in the next ten minutes.
Set your target exam and date. Then break it into the chapters you must finish each month.
Wake at 04:30, study the planned subjects, exercise, and sleep on time — every day, not only on motivated days.
Record your time each week. Small weekly cuts add up to minutes over a few months.
A stable government job, a family that never has to worry about money, and the self-respect that comes from knowing I did not waste my years.
